notice_texts: LATEST NEWS Chhattisgarh AYSUH PG 2026 Round-1 Registration & Choice Filling Started. New As per the order of the Government of India, Ministry of Ayush Dated 19.10.2026, the 2nd appeal filed by "Bharti ayurved medical college and hospital, Durg" has been disposed with denial of permission for admission by Central Government. So, no allotment has been done against seats of Bharti Ayurved Medical College and Hospital, Durg. New
